{{Short description|Norwegian soil scientist}}
'''Harald Bergseth''' (11 July 1923 – 28 April 2012) was a [[Norway|Norwegian]] [[soil science|soil scientist]].

He hailed from [[Gudbrandsdalen]]. He took his master's degree in [[physical geography]] at the [[University of Oslo]], later another degree in [[physical chemistry]] as well as the [[dr.agric.]] degree. He was a professor in [[soil science]] at the [[Norwegian College of Agriculture]] until the age of 71, later professor emeritus. He was a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]. He resided in [[Ås, Akershus|Ås]] and died in April 2012.<ref>{{cite news|title=Harald Bergseth|last=Stuanes, Arne O.|author2=Tore Krogstad |author3=Gunnar Abrahamsen |date=23 May 2012|work=Aftenposten|language=Norwegian}}</ref><ref>[http://tux.aftenposten.no/personalia/paperadsobi/779066.pdf Death announcement]{{dead link|date=November 2017 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
